sections.text: [OPEN: either the VAT identification number under Section 27a of the German VAT Act (UStG) (format DE + 9 digits) — or, if none has been issued, the statement "No VAT identification number has been issued."; if the small business regulation under Section 19 UStG applies, additionally: "No VAT is charged pursuant to Section 19 UStG."]

sections.heading: Responsible for content
sections.text: This website does not contain journalistic-editorial content (no blog, no news section); a separate statement under Section 18(2) of the German Interstate Media Treaty (MStV) is therefore not currently required. Responsibility for the content of these pages lies with the provider named above, represented by the persons named under "Represented by".

sections.heading: Consumer dispute resolution
sections.text: We are not willing and not obliged to participate in dispute resolution proceedings before a consumer arbitration board (Section 36 of the German Consumer Dispute Resolution Act, VSBG). The European Commission's Online Dispute Resolution platform was discontinued on 20 July 2025; a reference to it is therefore omitted.

sections.heading: Note on this text
sections.text: This draft is derived from the service's actual behavior and does not replace legal advice. As long as the details marked above are missing, this page does not fully satisfy the provider identification requirements of Section 5 of the German Digital Services Act (DDG).
